item.title: Shabbat Shalom!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Shabbat Shalom!

item.title: IDF strikes Syrian terrorist who operated under the direction of the Iranian regime
item.description:
The IDF on Friday conducted a precise aerial strike targeting the terrorist Yusuf Ali Al-Hassoun, said the IDF Spokesperson's Unit.
It added that Al-Hassoun operated under the direction of the Iranian regime and advanced terrorist attacks targeting Israeli civilians and IDF soldiers operating in southern Syria.
Over the past year, said the IDF, Al-Hassoun planned and advanced attacks against IDF soldiers that were thwarted, including the launching of explosive drones and rockets toward IDF soldiers in southern Syria.
(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

item.title: Netanyahu welcomes US sanctions on ICC
item.description:

“The ICC is not a court. It is a political body that poses a mortal threat to law abiding democracies worldwide and to the very idea of national sovereignty. Thank you for your leadership," said Netanyahu.
